review_candidates.title: Guest Experience Expert / Receptionist
review_candidates.description: Additional Information Job Number 26110715 Job Category Rooms & Guest Services Operations Location 6 Pyramids Road, Cairo, Egypt, Egypt, 12556VIEW ON MAP Schedule Full Time Located Remotely? N Position Type Non-Management Position Summary Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience. No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time. Preferred Qualifications Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent. Related Work Experience: No related work experience. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience. License or Certification: None At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law. Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of “Wonderful Hospitality. Always.” by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you. JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you’re happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand’s namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you’ll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That’s The JW Treatment™. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

review_candidates.title: BIM Structural Engineer – Steel Design
review_candidates.description: MHCEG is seeking an experienced BIM Structural Engineer for our structural Engineering department. The required role is responsible for the structural design, analysis, and BIM modelling of steel structures. The role involves developing accurate structural models, design calculations, and coordinated construction drawings in compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project requirements. Key Responsibilities: Perform structural analysis and design of steel structural elements (beams, columns, bracing systems, connections, and frames). Demonstrate a strong interest in continuous professional development, with knowledge of codes such as AISC, ASCE, Eurocode 3, CSA, NBCC, and IBC considered a plus. Develop and manage BIM models for steel structural systems using software such as Revit and/or Tekla Structures. Prepare detailed steel shop drawings, connection details, schedules, and material quantities in accordance with project specifications. Coordinate structural models with architectural and MEP disciplines to identify and resolve clashes and ensure constructability. Ensure designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and project specifications. Review and optimize steel designs for structural safety, constructability, and cost efficiency. Participate in design reviews, technical meetings, and BIM coordination workshops. Support fabrication and construction teams by providing technical clarifications and responding to RFIs. Maintain accurate documentation, model revisions, and version control for drawings and BIM models. Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor's degree in civil or Structural Engineering, with 3 to 5 years of experience in steel design. Proven experience in structural steel design and detailing. Strong proficiency in BIM tools (Revit Structure, Tekla Structures, Navisworks). Experience with structural analysis and design software (ETABS, RISA, Robot, RAM Steel, IDEA StatiCa, etc.). Solid understanding of steel design principles, connections, and fabrication processes. Good knowledge of BIM workflows, LOD requirements, and interdisciplinary coordination. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Effective communication and technical documentation abilities.
